heading.en: Origins, studies and first public posts

body.zh-Hant: 阿薩尼亞1880年1月10日生於阿爾卡拉德埃納雷斯。他1898年在薩拉戈薩大學取得法學學位，兩年後在馬德里大學提出博士論文《群眾的責任》。1910年，他進入司法與公證登記總局任職；1911年2月4日，他在阿爾卡拉德埃納雷斯人民之家的啟用典禮上發表第一場政治演講《西班牙問題》。
body.en: Azaña was born at Alcalá de Henares on 10 January 1880. He took his law degree at the University of Zaragoza in 1898 and, two years later, presented his doctoral thesis, The Responsibility of the Multitudes, at the University of Madrid. In 1910 he joined the General Directorate of Registries and Notaries as an official, and on 4 February 1911, at the inauguration of the House of the People of Alcalá de Henares, he gave his first political lecture, The Spanish Problem.

heading.zh-Hant: 巴黎、文學會與共和主義

body.zh-Hant: 1911年11月至1912年10月，阿薩尼亞住在巴黎；他加入改良黨，1913年2月起擔任馬德里文學會（Ateneo）秘書，直到1920年。第一次世界大戰期間，他堅定支持協約國。他競選普恩特德爾阿爾索比斯波選區議員，1918年與1923年都失敗；1923年9月政變後，他公開表明反對普里莫·德里維拉的獨裁，並參與1925年創建共和行動黨（Acción Republicana）。他1926年獲國家文學獎；1930年6月，他當選馬德里文學會會長。
body.en: From November 1911 to October 1912 Azaña stayed in Paris. He joined the Reformist Party, and in February 1913 he became secretary of the Ateneo de Madrid, a post he held until 1920. During the First World War he was a staunch defender of the Allied cause. His candidacy for a deputy's seat at Puente del Arzobispo failed in 1918 and 1923; after the coup of September 1923 he declared his rejection of Primo de Rivera's dictatorship and took part in the creation of Acción Republicana in 1925. He received the National Prize of Literature in 1926, and in June 1930 he was elected president of the Ateneo de Madrid.

heading.zh-Hant: 陸軍部長與共和國初期改革
heading.en: War minister and the early reforms of the Republic

body.zh-Hant: 1931年4月14日，阿薩尼亞獲任命為陸軍部長（Ministro de la Guerra），官方公報刊出的任命令署日為4月14日。他推動軍隊改革，並在1931年10月於陸軍部之外加任政府首相。1931年12月憲法通過；1932年8月桑胡霍政變失敗後，議會通過加泰隆尼亞自治章程與土地改革法。1933年9月12日，他辭去陸軍部長職務。
body.en: On 14 April 1931 Azaña was appointed Minister of War; the decree published in the Gaceta is dated that day. He pushed the reform of the army and in October 1931 added the presidency of the government to the War portfolio. The Constitution was approved in December 1931, and after the failure of General Sanjurjo's coup in August 1932 the Cortes approved the Statute of Catalonia and the Agrarian Reform Law. On 12 September 1933 his resignation as Minister of War was accepted.

body.zh-Hant: 1933年11月選舉由右翼聯盟西班牙自治權利聯盟（CEDA）獲勝；阿薩尼亞在1934年4月創建左翼共和黨（Izquierda Republicana）。他因出席友人葬禮前往巴塞隆納，被控涉入加泰隆尼亞共和國的宣布，遭拘押於港內船艦，後來兩項指控都獲判無罪。1935年，他以露天集會演說成為共和左派的代表人物；1936年2月16日，左翼人民陣線贏得選舉。
body.en: The right-wing coalition CEDA won the elections of November 1933, and in April 1934 Azaña founded Izquierda Republicana (the Republican Left). Having gone to Barcelona for the funeral of a friend, he was accused of taking part in the proclamation of the Catalan republic and was held on ships in the port; he was later acquitted of both accusations. In 1935 he emerged as the great figure of the republican left through his open-field speeches, and on 16 February 1936 the left-wing Popular Front won the elections.

heading.zh-Hant: 首相、共和國總統與流亡
heading.en: Premier, President of the Republic and exile

body.zh-Hant: 1936年2月19日，阿薩尼亞接掌政府，同年5月10日當選共和國總統。7月，非洲軍團起事反對共和國政府；戰事期間總統府在10月中旬離開首都，遷往巴塞隆納。他1939年2月5日離開西班牙，2月27日提出辭去共和國總統職務。他最後落腳法國蒙托邦，1940年11月3日夜間死於南方旅館（Hôtel du Midi），葬於蒙托邦。
body.en: On 19 February 1936 Azaña took over the government, and on 10 May he was elected President of the Republic. In July the army of Africa rose against the Republic; the Presidency left the capital in mid-October and settled in Barcelona. He left Spain on 5 February 1939 and on 27 February presented his resignation as president of the Republic. He finally settled in Montauban in France; he died at the Hôtel du Midi on the night of 3 November 1940 and was buried in Montauban.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、律師與社會主義運動
heading.en: Origins, the bar and the socialist movement

body.zh-Hant: 白里安1862年3月28日生於南特，雙親在當地經營旅店。他當過律師和記者，1889年、1893年8月與1898年的立法選舉都沒有成功，其間他與維維亞尼、饒勒斯、富尼耶爾結交，並與他們共同創立「法蘭西社會黨」。1902年，他終於當選聖艾蒂安的眾議員。
body.en: Aristide Briand was born at Nantes on 28 March 1862, the son of innkeepers. He practised as a lawyer and worked as a journalist; he failed in the legislative elections of 1889, in August 1893 and again in 1898, in the meantime he formed ties with Viviani, Jaurès and Fournière and with them founded the 'French Socialist Party'. In 1902 he was at last elected deputy for Saint-Étienne.

heading.zh-Hant: 眾議員、政教分離法與司法部
heading.en: Deputy, the Separation law and the Ministry of Justice

body.zh-Hant: 白里安1902年4月27日起擔任盧瓦爾省眾議員。當選三年後，他擔任政教分離法案的報告人，並使法案獲得多數通過。1906年3月14日他進入薩里安內閣，出任公共教育與宗教事務部長，後來在克里蒙梭內閣續任；他加入政府時被逐出社會黨。1908年1月4日，他改任司法部長，並由此掌管宗教事務，直到1909年7月克里蒙梭辭職。
body.en: Briand sat as deputy for the Loire from 27 April 1902. Three years after his election he was the rapporteur of the bill separating the Churches from the State, which a large majority adopted. On 14 March 1906 he entered the Sarrien cabinet as minister of public instruction and worship and kept that post under Clemenceau; on joining the government he was expelled from the Socialist Party. From 4 January 1908 he took the Ministry of Justice, to which Worship was attached, until Clemenceau's resignation in July 1909.

heading.en: First premiership and the railway strike

body.zh-Hant: 1909年7月24日克里蒙梭辭職後，白里安出任總理，並兼內政與宗教事務部長。1910年他徵用罷工的鐵路人員，10月31日茹爾·蓋得與74名社會黨議員要求對他提出控訴，但眾議院支持他；他於11月3日辭職，重組內閣不久後又在1911年2月27日下台。1912年1月14日他在普恩加萊內閣任司法部長；1913年1月21日組成第三屆內閣。
body.en: After Clemenceau's resignation on 24 July 1909 Briand became president of the Council, holding the Interior and Worship portfolios as well. In 1910 he requisitioned the striking railway personnel; on 31 October Jules Guesde and the socialist deputies asked for his indictment but the Chamber approved him, and he resigned on 3 November. He reformed the ministry but resigned again on 27 February 1911. On 14 January 1912 he became minister of justice in Poincaré's cabinet, and on 21 January 1913 he formed his third cabinet.

heading.en: In government during the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月26日，白里安在維維亞尼的國民聯合內閣出任司法部長兼副總理，任職至1915年10月29日。接著他自己組閣，這是他的第五屆內閣；他是薩洛尼卡遠征的推動者之一，並在1915年12月的加萊會議上使開闢巴爾幹新戰線的構想獲得採納。1916年12月12日他重組內閣、設立戰爭委員會。1917年3月14日利奧泰辭去陸軍部長，導致內閣倒台。
body.en: On 26 August 1914 Briand took the portfolio of Justice and became Vice-President of the Council in Viviani's national-union cabinet, and kept that post until 29 October 1915. He then headed his own, fifth cabinet; he was one of the architects of the Salonika expedition and won acceptance for the idea of a new Balkan front at the Calais conference of December 1915. On 12 December 1916 he reshuffled his ministry to include a standing War Committee. The resignation of Lyautey as minister of war on 14 March 1917 brought the cabinet down.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後外交部長與華盛頓、坎城會議
heading.en: Foreign minister after the war: Washington and Cannes

body.zh-Hant: 戰後白里安1921年1月16日再度組閣，並由自己兼任外交部長。他處理賠款問題、代表法國出席華盛頓軍備會議，1922年在坎城與勞合喬治談判安全協定；1月12日，他在議會反對聲中提出辭職。這屆內閣期間，他爭取恢復法國駐梵蒂岡大使館。
body.en: After the war Briand formed a new cabinet on 16 January 1921, keeping the foreign affairs portfolio for himself. He sought a settlement of the reparations issue, represented France at the Washington Arms Conference, and negotiated a security pact with Lloyd George at Cannes in 1922; he resigned on 12 January 1922 amid growing opposition in Parliament. During this ministry he also obtained the re-establishment of the French embassy to the Vatican.

heading.zh-Hant: 外交部長、羅卡諾與諾貝爾和平獎
heading.en: Foreign minister, Locarno and the Nobel Peace Prize

body.zh-Hant: 1925年4月白里安在潘勒維內閣重返權力，並出任外交部長；10月羅卡諾會議後，他於1925年11月28日再度組閣。1926年他與施特雷澤曼同獲諾貝爾和平獎。1926年7月23日起，他又在普恩加萊內閣主管外交，同年9月與施特雷澤曼在圖瓦會晤。1928年8月27日，十五國在巴黎簽署白里安－凱洛格公約，宣告放棄戰爭。
body.en: In April 1925 Briand returned to power in Painlevé's cabinet at the foreign ministry, and after the Locarno conference of October 1925 he took the premiership again on 28 November 1925. In 1926 he shared the Nobel Peace Prize with Stresemann. From 23 July 1926 he again directed foreign affairs in Poincaré's cabinets, and in September 1926 he met Stresemann at Thoiry. On 27 August 1928 fifteen nations signed the Pact of Paris, the Kellogg-Briand Pact, renouncing war.

heading.zh-Hant: 最後的內閣、總統競選與逝世
heading.en: Last cabinet, the presidential bid and death

body.zh-Hant: 1929年7月29日，白里安組成他的第十一屆也是最後一屆內閣，其後的各屆內閣仍把外交部交給他；1930年5月他向二十六國遞交歐洲聯盟備忘錄。1931年5月13日，他參選共和國總統，首輪得401票，輸給得442票的杜梅，隨即退出。1932年1月14日他離開外交部，同年3月7日在巴黎去世。
body.en: On 29 July 1929 Briand formed his eleventh and last cabinet, and in the ministries that followed the direction of foreign affairs was still entrusted to him; in May 1930 he sent a memorandum on a European Union to twenty-six nations. On 13 May 1931 he stood for the presidency of the Republic but won only 401 votes against Paul Doumer's 442 in the first round and withdrew. He left the Quai d'Orsay on 14 January 1932 and died in Paris on 7 March 1932.

heading.en: Origins, the law and the war years

body.zh-Hant: 雅斯帕1870年7月28日生於斯哈爾貝克，在布魯塞爾自由大學讀法律；他在普林斯指導下，與埃內比克共創大學犯罪學社團，1907年又與德里克雷創辦《刑法與犯罪學評論》。他曾任比利時律師聯合會秘書長，到1912年為止。第一次世界大戰期間，他留在布魯塞爾，代表律師界抗議占領者違法，並參與全國賑濟與糧食委員會；他多次被捕。
body.en: Henri Jaspar was born at Schaerbeek on 28 July 1870 and studied law at the Free University of Brussels; under Adolphe Prins he founded a university criminology circle with Léon Hennebicq, and in 1907 he founded the Revue de droit pénal et de criminologie with De Ryckere. He was secretary general of the Belgian federation of bars until 1912. During the First World War he stayed in Brussels, voiced the Bar's protests against the occupier's violations of citizens' rights and took part in the National Relief and Food Committee; he was arrested several times.

heading.en: Post-war cabinets and the Foreign Ministry

body.zh-Hant: 1918年11月，雅斯帕在德拉克魯瓦領導的聯合內閣出任經濟事務部長；1919至1936年，他以天主教黨身分，在列日選區當選。1920年6月2日至11月20日他掌管內政部，並從9月30日起代理陸軍部。1920年11月20日至1924年3月11日他主持外交部，代表比利時出席熱那亞、海牙等會議。1924年3月11日，議會否決法比商約案，他辭職，隔天被任命為國務大臣。
body.en: In November 1918 Jaspar entered the Union-sacrée cabinet led by Léon Delacroix as minister of economic affairs; from 1919 to 1936 he sat as an elected member for Liège in the ranks of the Catholic party. From 2 June to 20 November 1920 he ran the Ministry of the Interior, acting also for the Ministry of War from 30 September. From 20 November 1920 to 11 March 1924 he headed the Foreign Ministry and often represented Belgium at conferences such as Genoa and The Hague. He resigned on 11 March 1924 after Parliament rejected a Franco-Belgian commercial agreement, and was named minister of state the next day.

heading.zh-Hant: 首相兼內政部長與殖民部長

body.zh-Hant: 1926年5月20日，波萊－范德維爾德政府失敗後，雅斯帕成為首相，同時兼任內政部長，組成有弗蘭基扮演要角的聯合政府。這屆政府以貨幣貶值穩定法郎，1927年初社會黨閣員退出後仍執政到1931年6月5日。1927年1月20日他放下內政部，改掌殖民部，保有到1929年10月底；1930年3月起又以正式部長身分主管殖民部，直到仁金內閣在1931年6月5日組成。
body.en: On 20 May 1926, after the failure of a Poullet-Vandervelde government, Jaspar became prime minister and minister of the Interior at the head of a new Union-sacrée government in which Francqui played a leading part. The government stabilised the franc by devaluation and, after the socialist members withdrew at the start of 1927, stayed in power until 5 June 1931. On 20 January 1927 he gave up the Interior for the Colonies, which he kept until the end of October 1929; from March 1930 he again held the Colonies as titular minister until the Renkin cabinet was formed on 5 June 1931.

heading.zh-Hant: 外交部長、組閣失敗與逝世
heading.en: Foreign minister, a failed formation and death

body.zh-Hant: 1931年下台後，雅斯帕又以財政部長身分進入德布洛克維爾內閣，並在1934年6月12日改任外交部長。1934年11月該內閣倒台時，他組閣失敗；一份研究指出，弗蘭基在最後一刻撤回支持，使他的嘗試落空，新內閣於11月20日成立。1939年2月12日，國王又請他組閣，以接替倒台的斯巴克政府；他因手術而放棄，並在2月15日死於術後栓塞。
body.en: After 1931 Jaspar re-entered government as minister of Finance in a cabinet presided over by Count de Broqueville, and on 12 June 1934 he moved from Finance to Foreign Affairs. When that cabinet fell in November 1934 he failed to form a successor; a study notes that Francqui withdrew his support at the last moment and so frustrated his attempt, and the new cabinet was installed on 20 November. On 12 February 1939 the King again charged him with forming a government to replace the fallen Spaak government; he had to give up because of surgery and died of a post-operative embolism on 15 February.
